keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One or more search terms, e.g. utvikler, sykepleier, ingeniør. Each keyword is searched separately and duplicate jobs are removed. Leave empty to list all jobs.

keyword.title: Single keyword (optional)
keyword.description: Shortcut for one search term. Added to the Keywords list.

counties.title: Counties (fylker)
counties.description: Only jobs in these counties. Leave empty for all of Norway.

municipalities.title: Municipalities (kommuner)
municipalities.description: Format COUNTY.MUNICIPALITY, e.g. ROGALAND.HAUGESUND, OSLO.OSLO, TRØNDELAG.TRONDHEIM.

sector.title: Sector
sector.description: Public or private sector. Leave empty for both.

remote.title: Home office
remote.description: Home-office policy. Leave empty for any.

needDriversLicense.title: Driver's licence
needDriversLicense.description: true = licence required, false = not required. Leave empty for any.

publishedWithin.title: Published within
publishedWithin.description: Only jobs published within this window. Leave empty for all.

hasSuperraskSoknad.title: Quick apply only
hasSuperraskSoknad.description: Only jobs with NAV's quick-apply (Superrask søknad).

isSummerJob.title: Summer jobs only
isSummerJob.description: Only jobs flagged as summer jobs.

isUnder18.title: Suitable for under 18
isUnder18.description: Only jobs suitable for people under 18.

maxResults.title: Maximum number of jobs
maxResults.description: Total number of jobs to save across all keywords. 0 = no limit (all matching jobs).

includeDetails.title: Fetch full ad details
includeDetails.description: Adds the full description (text and HTML), employment type, work hours, start date, employer details, contact application link and AI competences. Turn off for the fastest basic listing.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. NAV is open and works without a proxy; enable Apify Proxy only if you get blocked or rate limited.
